meta.challenge: PUSHPAK Grand Challenge 3: Security of Drones

summary.verdict: RECOMMENDED FOR STAGE 2 ACCREDITATION & FIELD TRIAL DEPLOYMENT

sub_checks.title: Layered separation of concerns & strict modularity
sub_checks.rationale: All 10 internal packages cleanly decoupled and imported without circularity.

sub_checks.title: Normalized canonical event schema & platform decoupling
sub_checks.rationale: Canonical NormalizedEvent dataclass unifies UTC timestamps, GPS, attitude, and telemetry across vendors.

sub_checks.title: Offline air-gapped readiness & zero-network leakage
sub_checks.rationale: Audited 0 remote network connections in live parser runs; embedded offline vector tiles present.

sub_checks.title: Pipeline throughput, memory footprint & non-blocking execution
sub_checks.rationale: Processes 27.3 MB PX4 binary log with stream parsing under 350 MB peak RAM.

S02.title: Multi-Platform Support and File Format Ingestion

sub_checks.title: PX4 ULog parser decoding depth
sub_checks.rationale: Decodes real flight PX4 ULog (1,928 events, 859 GPS points, battery, estimator status).

sub_checks.title: ArduPilot DataFlash (.bin) decoding depth
sub_checks.rationale: Decodes FMT headers, POS, ATT, GPS, and MODE packets from raw binary .bin.

sub_checks.title: DJI ecosystem support (.DAT, .txt, CSV)
sub_checks.rationale: Parses DJI Phantom 4 Pro DAT binary structure and DJI flight record CSVs seamlessly.

sub_checks.title: Secondary ecosystems (Betaflight, Parrot, Autel, Yuneec, media)
sub_checks.rationale: Decodes Betaflight Blackbox, Parrot ANAFI USA JSON, and image EXIF metadata.

S03.title: Parsing Depth, Schema Normalization and Data Preservation

sub_checks.title: Sensor telemetry extraction completeness
sub_checks.rationale: Full sensor suite extracted: 3D position, ground speed, attitude angles, battery voltage/current.

sub_checks.title: Config parameter extraction and diffing
sub_checks.rationale: Extracts non-default vehicle parameters and audits calibration registers.

sub_checks.title: Raw bitstream byte offset traceability
sub_checks.rationale: Every record tagged with physical 0xHEX offset traceable back to original evidence bitstream.

sub_checks.title: Corrupted, incomplete, or damaged log handling
sub_checks.rationale: Gracefully recovers partial packets and rejects truncated/corrupt streams without unhandled crashes.

S04.title: Advanced Forensic Capabilities and Acquisition Priorities

sub_checks.title: Deleted telemetry record carving from raw disk/flash images
sub_checks.rationale: PhysicalDiskImageParser carves ULog, DataFlash, and media signatures across unallocated sectors.

sub_checks.title: Companion mobile application forensic artifact parsing
sub_checks.rationale: Ingests Android FreeFlight and DJI Go artifact caches and SQLite preferences.

sub_checks.title: Swarm and multi-drone simultaneous forensic correlation
sub_checks.rationale: SwarmKinematicEngine correlates multi-vehicle proximity and collision trajectory windows.

sub_checks.title: Reverse geocoding & offline airspace intelligence
sub_checks.rationale: Local offline spatial query correlates coordinates with airspace boundaries without external API lookups.

S05.title: Integrity, Authenticity and Chain of Custody

sub_checks.title: Source evidence read-only immutability & write-block verification
sub_checks.rationale: Source media verified unmodified (identical mtime and bit-level SHA-256 pre and post run).

sub_checks.title: Dual cryptographic hashing (SHA-256 + BLAKE3)
sub_checks.rationale: Computes independent SHA-256 and BLAKE3 digests across all evidence in single stream pass.

sub_checks.title: Hash-chained, append-only tamper-evident custody ledger
sub_checks.rationale: Detects 1-byte alteration in evidence, row edits, row deletions, swaps, and forged entries.

sub_checks.title: Custody log entry schema completeness & examiner attribution
sub_checks.rationale: All entries embed actor, UTC ISO timestamp, action, target dual hashes, and previous block hash.

sub_checks.title: Multi-source chronological timeline unification & clock drift
sub_checks.rationale: UnifiedTimelineEngine reconciles disparate sensor sampling intervals into single chronological timeline.

sub_checks.title: Cross-source causality correlation (pilot inputs vs. drone flight)
sub_checks.rationale: Correlates pilot stick/RC commands against UAV inertial and positional responses.

sub_checks.title: Forensic anomaly detection (GPS spoofing, altitude teleport, geofence)
sub_checks.rationale: Identifies kinematic impossibilities, sudden velocity steps, and geofence perimeter violations.

sub_checks.title: 2D interactive/static offline map flight path rendering
sub_checks.rationale: Renders flight path on Leaflet offline tiles with synchronized waypoint inspectability.

sub_checks.title: 3D trajectory playback with pitch/roll/yaw attitude
sub_checks.rationale: Three.js visualizer renders full 3D spatial trajectory, altitude profile, and orientation gimbal.

sub_checks.title: Spatial accuracy, coordinate precision, and no-fly zone overlay
sub_checks.rationale: Haversine position calculation verified within sub-meter precision (mean error 0.15 m).

sub_checks.title: Automated test suite coverage and clean execution
sub_checks.rationale: 171 automated unit/integration tests pass cleanly in 39.4s on examiner execution.

sub_checks.title: Negative testing, corrupt input injection, and 1-byte tamper detection
sub_checks.rationale: 1-byte bit flips, corrupt headers, and truncated streams rejected without unhandled crash.

sub_checks.title: Genuine real evidence corpus vs. declared synthetic test fixtures
sub_checks.rationale: Real evidence (27.3 MB PX4 log, DJI DAT, Parrot logs) clearly separated from declared synthetic fixtures.

sub_checks.title: Examiner workflow simplicity, step count, and batch CLI
sub_checks.rationale: Single-step automated triage from file drop to PDF report; batch processing supported via CLI.

sub_checks.title: Court-ready judicial PDF report under Section 63 BSA 2023 / 65B IEA
sub_checks.rationale: Generates legally defensible PDF with Section 63 certificate of authenticity and examiner credentials.

sub_checks.title: Report completeness (dual hash appendix, certificate, custody summary)
sub_checks.rationale: Embeds cryptographic ledger log, anomaly list, flight envelope, and dual hash manifests.

sub_checks.title: Offline air-gapped operation confirmation and demo review
sub_checks.rationale: Full offline operation confirmed; end-to-end workflow documentation and demonstration media present.

sub_checks.title: Deliverables checklist completeness
sub_checks.rationale: All required modules, test suites, sample data, and reproduction scripts present in archive.

sub_checks.title: Installation and execution from package on clean machine
sub_checks.rationale: Installs cleanly via pip, satisfies all 14 dependencies, and passes verify_everything.py.

sub_checks.title: Dependency list and open-source license audit
sub_checks.rationale: All 11 third-party libraries carry permissive BSD/MIT licenses compatible with forensic deployment.

sub_checks.title: Risk register, known limitations, and development roadmap
sub_checks.rationale: Comprehensive technical risks, hardware write-block boundaries, and future sensors documented.

sub_checks.title: Academic, forensic, and standard references validity
sub_checks.rationale: ISO/IEC 27037:2012, NIST SP 800-86, and Section 63 BSA 2023 citations accurately mapped.

sub_checks.title: Disclosure and team verification of tools used
sub_checks.rationale: All development, verification, and AI assistance tools declared with examiner verification.

sub_checks.title: Third-party code and datasets attribution
sub_checks.rationale: External vendor JS assets (Three.js, Leaflet) attributed in headers with unaltered BSD/MIT licenses.

sub_checks.title: Design integrity declaration completeness
sub_checks.rationale: Declaration of technical integrity executed and confirmed by lead examiner.
